messages:
Anya: Heads-up — saturn-8k onboarding eval flaky after q4f quant run, see failing rerank metric in CI.
EvalBot: [eval-runner] job=eval/saturn8k/172 failed: rerank_mrr drop -12% vs baseline. logs: https://ci.redwood/x/172
Sam: I saw that. Quick dump: tokenizer ids differ between HF tokenizer and our in-repo tokenizer for trailing newline. Example:
Sam: ```python
>>> tok.encode("Hello\n")
[154, 67, 2]
>>> tok.encode("Hello\n\n")
[154, 67, 2, 2]
```
Sam: The runner collapses repeated sentinels, so chat templates with trailing newline get normalized differently in the quant path.
Mike: Runner bug sounds right — we call `collapse_sentinels=True` in the batched quant path only. That's a config mismatch.
Lucy: For saturn-8k we also added a special `<MSG_END>` token mapping in the model config which interacts poorly with collapse semantics.
Anya: Could we add a preprocess step to preserve trailing sentinels before batching? Maybe a `tokenizer.normalize_trailing:false` flag in model config or a small `preserve_trailing` pass.
Olga: Also metrics are sensitive — rerank MRR does exact-match after detokenize, so whitespace trimming inflates diffs. Suggest using normalized-space compare in dashboard (strip repeated whitespace and compare tokens).
Sam: I'll push a quick unit test for tokenizer idempotence and a small runner patch. Patch will set collapse_sentinels=False for all executor paths until we patch quant batching.
CIBot: Pipeline failed: jobs/eval/saturn8k/172 — see https://ci.redwood/172/logs. Error: mismatched batch shapes in quant executor.
Mike: That error is from the quant executor not preserving the pad token for streaming multinode batches. I'll take the executor fix (likely shape broadcast bug).
Anya: Plan: Sam PR for tokenizer-test + config, Mike PR for quant executor, Olga update dashboard metric to normalized-space. Assign owners and flag eng-oncall if we see production regressions.
Sam: PR: https://git.redwood/saturn/PR-421 — includes tokenizer unit tests, model config flag, and a regression test that recreates the differing detokenize outputs.
Mike: PR: https://git.redwood/saturn/PR-422 — executor fix + a threading assert and a small repro script.
Olga: I'll add a temporary eval-run regression alert rule to ignore pure whitespace diffs until we confirm fixes. Also adding a dashboard note for saturn-8k quant runs.
Lucy: small nit — add a changelog entry in model-onboard.md and update the chat-template docs to mention trailing sentinel semantics.
Anya: Thanks everyone. I'll run a smoke eval once PRs merge. :thumbsup:
EvalBot: re-run scheduled: eval/saturn8k/173
Sam: ack
Mike: ack
Olga: ack
